commands.test: npm run typecheck && npm run catalog:check && npm run cases:check && npm test && npm run eval

notes: Tests in src/db/*.db.test.ts and src/server/*.db.test.ts need local Postgres 16 (scripts/db-bootstrap.sh); without it they fail with ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:5432. Browser checks (npm run flow, npm run a11y) need a running server and Chromium. See README 'Check'.
